text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval to install a compulsory stop control at four, currently uncontrolled, "T" type intersections on McLean Avenue and on Silver Birch Avenue. Based on an assessment undertaken, the installation of compulsory stop control is recommended to clearly define the right-of-way and enhance safety for all road users.

The Toronto and East York Community Council authorized: 1. A compulsory stop control for eastbound traffic on Crown Park Road at McLean Avenue. 2. A compulsory stop control for eastbound traffic on Duart Park Road at McLean Avenue. 3. A compulsory stop control for westbound traffic on Balmy Avenue at Silver Birch Avenue. 4. A compulsory stop control for westbound traffic on Glenfern Avenue at Silver Birch Avenue.
